decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter is a low-cost accessory that was prominently launched and complements the firm's track lighting systems, so the option is kept open at little cost.
The single LED luminaire appears to have been superseded by the newer luminaire families (D and E), reducing its value as an option, so it is likely to be dropped.
The home automation server box has high uncertainty and likely higher support costs, and with no evidence of success after four years, the option is abandoned.
The luminaire family is a core offering with its own product page and likely stable demand, so the firm keeps this option.
